$comment: What npm run setup leaves out of a new project. 'reference' is the UPEX reference implementation that lives in the template repository (ADR-007); 'templateOnly' builds and tests the template itself; 'scripts' are package.json scripts for those files; 'performance' lists the files and devDependencies only the performance module needs, removed when it is not enabled. Everything else is copied, and the starter files from framework/setup/starter are added.
